title: Operation SOS authored content front matter
description: Front matter of playbooks/scenarios/*.md (scenario), modules/*.md (module), cards/*.md (card) and pages/*.md (page). sos validate-playbooks validates each file against the $defs entry for its directory; the rules are explained in playbooks/README.md.

id.description: The slug; must equal the file name without .md.

title.description: The heading, also shown in search results.

icon.description: An icon name from the frontend's vocabulary; unknown names render as a book.

order.description: Sort position within its kind (scenarios use the numbers from spec section 2).

summary.description: One sentence for tiles and lists.

source.description: A cited source. doc or kiwix names the library copy; url is provenance only and is never rendered as a link.

title.description: How the source is listed under the document.

doc.description: Manifest id of a pdf or epub item.

url.description: Where the source came from; provenance only.

as_at.description: Date of the cited edition: YYYY-MM-DD, or YYYY-MM when only the month is known.

scenario.description: playbooks/scenarios/<slug>.md: one of the twenty scenario playbooks.

modules.description: Module slugs; each must be included in the body with {{module:<slug>}}.

overlays.description: Overlay ids from manifest/overlays.json switched on when the map opens from this playbook.

reviewed.description: The owner's sign-off date (YYYY-MM-DD), or null until reviewed.

sources.description: The sources the playbook was written from.

module.description: playbooks/modules/<slug>.md: shared content included by playbooks and readable on its own.

sources.description: The sources the module was written from.

card.description: playbooks/cards/<slug>.md: a one-screen medical quick card.

sources.description: The sources the card was written from.

page.description: playbooks/pages/<slug>.md: a comms, reference, plan or about page.

category.description: Which list the page appears in: comms (the Phone and radio screen), reference, plan (the Plan screen), about, or fieldcraft (the Field craft screen).

sources.description: The sources the page was written from.
